title: SELECTEDVALUE returns the alternate result when no value is visible
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color], "None" ), Product[Color] = "Purple" ) )

source.quote: If the filter context returns zero rows for the referenced column, then SELECTEDVALUE returns the second argument
source.supports: zero visible values give the alternate, not only two or more

derivation: No product is Purple, so Product[Color] has no visible value. That is not exactly one value, so the alternate "None" is returned.
